f.title: Use C.1.3 value 2 (Report from study) for studies and for other solicited sources
f.statement: The C.1.3 value '2' (Report from study) is used for studies as well as for other solicited sources, as described in ICH E2D(R1).
f.clause: 3. Alignment of E2B(R3) with E2D(R1) - C.1.3 Type of Report, User Guidance
f.applicability: Solicited reports as described in ICH E2D(R1)

f.title: Treat C.5.4 Study Type as required when C.1.3 = 2
f.statement: C.5.4 Study Type is optional, but required if C.1.3 = 2 (Report from study); allowed values are 1 Clinical trials, 2 Individual patient use, 3 Other studies, 4 Patient Support Program, 5 Market Research Program, 6 Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform.
f.clause: 3. Alignment of E2B(R3) with E2D(R1) - C.5.4 Study Type, Conformance

rows.quote: Conformance Optional, but required if C.1.3 = 2 (Report from study). Data Type 1N OID 2.16.840.1.113883.3.989.2.1.1.8 Value Allowed 1 = Clinical trials 2 = Individual patient use (e.g., “compassionate use” or “named patient basis”) 3 = Other studies (e.g., pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacoeconomics, intensive monitoring) 4 = Patient Support Program 5 = Market Research Program 6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform

f.title: Take ICH E2D(R1) definitions into account when coding C.5.4
f.statement: The ICH E2D(R1) definitions of Patient Support Program, Market Research Program, Organised Data Collection System and Digital Platform should be taken into account when coding C.5.4.
f.clause: 3. Alignment of E2B(R3) with E2D(R1) - C.5.4 Study Type, User Guidance

rows.quote: Definitions provided in ICH E2D(R1) for Patient Support Program, Market Research Program, Organised Data Collection System and Digital Platform should be taken into account.

f.title: Use C.5.4 value 6 only for digital-platform ICSRs where no other study type applies
f.statement: Value '6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform' should only be used if the ICSR originated from a digital platform and none of the other study types (1-5) apply.
f.clause: 3. Alignment of E2B(R3) with E2D(R1) - C.5.4 Study Type, User Guidance

rows.quote: The value ‘6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform’ should only be used if the Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSR) originated from a digital platform and none of the other study types (1-5) apply.

f.title: Select C.5.4 value 6 for social listening on a digital platform not under MAH responsibility
f.statement: Value '6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform' should be selected if the ICSR originated from a digital platform in the context of social listening activity on a digital platform that is not under the responsibility of the MAH.
f.clause: 3. Alignment of E2B(R3) with E2D(R1) - C.5.4 Study Type, User Guidance

rows.quote: For example, value ‘6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform’ should be selected if the ICSR originated from a digital platform in the context of “social listening” activity on a digital platform that is not under the responsibility of the MAH.

f.title: Select C.5.4 value 4 for digital-platform ICSRs within a Patient Support Program
f.statement: If the ICSR originated from a digital platform in the context of a Patient Support Program, value '4 = Patient Support Program' should be selected instead of value 6.
f.clause: 3. Alignment of E2B(R3) with E2D(R1) - C.5.4 Study Type, User Guidance

rows.quote: If the ICSR originated from a digital platform in the context of a Patient Support Program, then the value ‘4 = Patient Support Program’ should be selected, instead of the value ‘6 = Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform’.

f.title: Use new C.5.4 values prospectively; no resubmission of ICSRs already submitted
f.statement: The new values for C.5.4 Study Type Where Reaction(s)/Event(s) Were Observed should be used prospectively.
f.exceptions: ICSRs already submitted do not need to be re-submitted with a new value (stated in the following bullet, which is not quoted because of a line-end hyphen).

f.title: Use new C.5.4 values in follow-up and amendment ICSRs
f.statement: When submitting a follow-up ICSR or an amendment report, the new C.5.4 values should be used as appropriate; e.g. a follow-up for a market research program case previously submitted should use '5 = Market Research Program'.

rows.quote: However, when submitting a follow-up ICSR or an amendment report, the new values should be used as appropriate. For example, submitting a follow-up ICSR for a case from a market research program that was previously submitted to the regulatory 3 authorities, the new value ‘5 = Market Research Program’ should be used in data element “C.5.4 Study Type Where Reaction(s) / Event(s) Were Observed”.
rows.review_note: Review: key prefix renamed from ICH-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN to FDA-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN-V1 (issuer first per GUIDE agency-document-version-sequence; catalog agency FDA; paper version 1.0). No other change. Double-check: quote carries the page number '3' mid-sentence.

f.title: Use new C.5.4 values for all new ICSRs, including from long-running solicited sources
f.statement: The new values should be used as appropriate for newly submitted ICSRs, not just for newly introduced solicited data sources; e.g. ICSRs from a patient support program running for years should use '4 = Patient Support Program' for all new and follow-up ICSRs from that program.

rows.quote: The new values should be used as appropriate for newly submitted ICSRs, not just for newly introduced solicited data sources. For example, ICSR submissions arising from a patient support program that has been running for years should use the new value ‘4 = Patient Support Program’ in data-element “C.5.4 Study Type Where Reaction(s) / Event(s) Were Observed” for all new and follow-up ICSRs submitted from this program.
rows.review_note: Review: key prefix renamed from ICH-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN to FDA-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN-V1 (issuer first per GUIDE agency-document-version-sequence; catalog agency FDA; paper version 1.0). No other change. Double-check: quote proves the rule.

f.title: No resubmission needed for ICSRs from programs no longer considered PSPs
f.statement: ICSRs already submitted to regulatory authorities for programs no longer considered PSPs under ICH E2D(R1) (e.g. one-way interaction activities such as home delivery, vouchers or coupons) do not need to be resubmitted with a new value.
f.applicability: Programs excluded by the ICH E2D(R1) PSP definition

rows.quote: ICSRs that have already been submitted to regulatory authorities for programs no longer considered PSPs do not need to be re-submitted with a new value.
rows.review_note: Review: key prefix renamed from ICH-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN to FDA-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN-V1 (issuer first per GUIDE agency-document-version-sequence; catalog agency FDA; paper version 1.0). No other change. Double-check: statement's examples (one-way interaction activities) and E2D(R1) context are outside the quote; 'do not need to be' read as Permitted.

f.title: Recode follow-ups from former PSPs as Spontaneous and leave C.5.4 empty
f.statement: When submitting a follow-up or amendment report for a previously submitted ICSR originating from programs no longer considered PSPs, C.1.3 Type of Report should be updated to '1 = Spontaneous report' and C.5.4 should be left empty.
f.applicability: Follow-up/amendment ICSRs from programs no longer considered PSPs

rows.quote: When submitting a follow-up or an amendment report for a previously submitted ICSR originating from these types of programs, the data-element “C.1.3 Type of Report” should be updated with the value ‘1 = Spontaneous report’ and the data-element “C.5.4 Study Type Where Reaction(s) / Event(s) Were Observed ” should be left empty.
rows.review_note: Review: key prefix renamed from ICH-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN to FDA-E2B-R3-E2D-ALIGN-V1 (issuer first per GUIDE agency-document-version-sequence; catalog agency FDA; paper version 1.0). No other change. Double-check: quote refers to 'these types of programs' (lead-in outside quote).

f.title: State in the follow-up narrative that the ICSR comes from a one-way interaction service program
f.statement: The case narrative of such a follow-up ICSR should also clarify that the ICSR originates from a one-way interactions service program and not from a patient support program.
f.applicability: Follow-up ICSRs from programs no longer considered PSPs

rows.quote: The case narrative of the follow-up ICSR should also clarify that the ICSR originates from a one-way interactions service program and not from a patient support program.

f.title: Use C.5.4 value 3 for PSP, market research and digital-platform ICSRs where a region has not implemented new values
f.statement: When a region has not yet implemented the new C.5.4 values, value '3 = Other studies' should be used for ICSRs originating from patient support programs, market research programs or organised data collection systems with source data from digital platforms.

rows.quote: When a region has not yet implemented the new values for data-element “C.5.4 Study Type Where Reaction(s) / Event(s) Were Observed”, the value ‘3 = Other studies (e.g., pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacoeconomics, intensive monitoring)’ should be used for ICSRs originating from patient support programs, market research programs or from organized data collection systems with source data from digital platforms.
